statement: Whenever has_special_substring s k returns a result r, r = true if and only if there exists an integer i such that 0 ≤ i, i + k ≤ n, for every j with i ≤ j < i + k we have s[j] = s[i], (i = 0 or s[i-1] ≠ s[i]), and (i + k = n or s[i+k] ≠ s[i]).
preconditions: Let n = len(s). The slice s has 1 ≤ n ≤ 100; the integer k (the i64 argument) satisfies 1 ≤ k ≤ n; and for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, s[i] is an ASCII lowercase English letter, i.e. 97 ≤ s[i] ≤ 122.

statement: For every s and k satisfying the preconditions, the evaluation of has_special_substring s k returns a result of the form Result.ok r for some Boolean r; it does not fail (no panic, out-of-bounds access, or arithmetic overflow).
preconditions: Let n = len(s). The slice s has 1 ≤ n ≤ 100; the integer k (the i64 argument) satisfies 1 ≤ k ≤ n; and for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, s[i] is an ASCII lowercase English letter, i.e. 97 ≤ s[i] ≤ 122.

statement: Whenever has_special_substring s k returns a result r, r = true if and only if there exists an integer i such that 0 ≤ i < n, (i = 0 or s[i-1] ≠ s[i]), and (i + 1 = n or s[i+1] ≠ s[i]).
preconditions: Let n = len(s). The slice s has 1 ≤ n ≤ 100; the integer k (the i64 argument) satisfies 1 ≤ k ≤ n; for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, s[i] is an ASCII lowercase English letter, i.e. 97 ≤ s[i] ≤ 122; and k = 1.

statement: Whenever has_special_substring s k returns a result r, r = true if and only if for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, s[i] = s[0].
preconditions: Let n = len(s). The slice s has 1 ≤ n ≤ 100; the integer k (the i64 argument) satisfies 1 ≤ k ≤ n; for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, s[i] is an ASCII lowercase English letter, i.e. 97 ≤ s[i] ≤ 122; and k = n.

statement: Whenever has_special_substring s k returns a result r, r = true if and only if k = 1.
preconditions: Let n = len(s). The slice s has 1 ≤ n ≤ 100; the integer k (the i64 argument) satisfies 1 ≤ k ≤ n; for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, s[i] is an ASCII lowercase English letter, i.e. 97 ≤ s[i] ≤ 122; and for every i with 0 ≤ i < n - 1, s[i] ≠ s[i+1].

statement: Whenever has_special_substring s k returns a result r, r = true if and only if k = n.
preconditions: Let n = len(s). The slice s has 1 ≤ n ≤ 100; the integer k (the i64 argument) satisfies 1 ≤ k ≤ n; for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, s[i] is an ASCII lowercase English letter, i.e. 97 ≤ s[i] ≤ 122; and for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, s[i] = s[0].

statement: Whenever has_special_substring s k returns a result r, if every maximal run of equal bytes in s has length strictly less than k, then r = false. Here a maximal run is an interval [i,j) with 0 ≤ i < j ≤ n such that all s[t] for i ≤ t < j are equal, (i = 0 or s[i-1] ≠ s[i]), and (j = n or s[j] ≠ s[i]); its length is j - i.
preconditions: Let n = len(s). The slice s has 1 ≤ n ≤ 100; the integer k (the i64 argument) satisfies 1 ≤ k ≤ n; and for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, s[i] is an ASCII lowercase English letter, i.e. 97 ≤ s[i] ≤ 122.

statement: Whenever has_special_substring s k returns a result r, if every maximal run of equal bytes in s has length strictly greater than k, then r = false. Here a maximal run is an interval [i,j) with 0 ≤ i < j ≤ n such that all s[t] for i ≤ t < j are equal, (i = 0 or s[i-1] ≠ s[i]), and (j = n or s[j] ≠ s[i]); its length is j - i.
preconditions: Let n = len(s). The slice s has 1 ≤ n ≤ 100; the integer k (the i64 argument) satisfies 1 ≤ k ≤ n; and for every i with 0 ≤ i < n, s[i] is an ASCII lowercase English letter, i.e. 97 ≤ s[i] ≤ 122.

statement: Whenever has_special_substring s k returns a result r1 and has_special_substring t k returns a result r2, we have r1 = r2.
preconditions: Let n = len(s). The common preconditions hold for (s,k): 1 ≤ n ≤ 100, 1 ≤ k ≤ n, and s has only ASCII lowercase letters. Let t be any byte slice of length n that also has only ASCII lowercase letters, and assume for all i,j with 0 ≤ i,j < n, s[i] = s[j] if and only if t[i] = t[j].

statement: Whenever has_special_substring s k returns a result r1 and has_special_substring rev k returns a result r2, we have r1 = r2.
preconditions: Let n = len(s). The common preconditions hold for (s,k): 1 ≤ n ≤ 100, 1 ≤ k ≤ n, and s has only ASCII lowercase letters. Let rev be the byte slice of length n defined by rev[i] = s[n - 1 - i] for 0 ≤ i < n.
